title: SPC convective outlook (Day 1-3)
description: A Storm Prediction Center convective outlook text product (Day 1 to 3). The map is a separate figure inject. Always an exercise product. Exercise product: the template adds an exercise banner. Real NWS office, center and station identifiers; the county, places and people are fictional.

examples: NWS Storm Prediction Center Norman OK

issued.description: Issuance line (local time of the center)

forecaster.description: Forecaster surname or initials, with the two dots prefix

riskHeadline.description: The risk statement line, upper case, starting with ...THERE IS
examples: ...THERE IS AN ENHANCED RISK OF SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING ACROSS THE MIDDLE OHIO VALLEY...
Severe thunderstorms capable of damaging winds, large hail and a few tornadoes are expected from the Ohio Valley into the central Appalachians this afternoon and evening.

heading.description: Area heading as in the product

examples: A cold front will move east into a warm, moist airmass. Surface dewpoints in the mid 60s and steep midlevel lapse rates will support MLCAPE near 2000 J/kg. Strong deep-layer shear favors supercells.
